subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the capitalised word in the given sentence. 

They tried to get official SANCTIONS for the scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e. **‘Permission’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanctions**: **(आधिकारिक अनुमति, (किसी काम की)** official permission to do or change something.

 
 
• **Example: **The project could not be started without the sanction of the government.
 
 
 
• **Permissions: (अनुमतियाँ) **Formal or official approval to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **She obtained the necessary permissions before starting construction on her property.
 
 
 
• Hence, ‘**Permission**’ is the **synonym **of ‘**Sanctions**’.

*Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Permission**’.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__
 
• **Committees: (समितियाँ) **Groups of people appointed to perform a specific task or make decisions.

 
 
• **Example: **The committee was formed to review the proposed changes to the company's policies.
 
 
 
• **Unholiness : (अधर्म)** The state of being impure, wicked, or contrary to religious or moral standards.
 
 
• **Example:** The villagers believed that the abandoned house was a place of unholiness and avoided it after dark.
 
 
 
• **Substances : (पदार्थ)** Materials or matter with distinct properties that can be physical, chemical, or biological in nature.
 
 
• **Example:** Chemists study various substances to understand their composition and properties.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
